lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: I heard you've opened a shop…

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: I understand, I'll drop by later.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: I need one book. Can you help?

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: So this is that new shop everyone's talking about. And here I thought the rumors were exaggerating.

lines.speaker: Morgan
lines.text: Rumors rarely exaggerate for the better. Come in — it's quiet right now.

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: Quiet is good. I can't stand picking books in a crowd.

lines.speaker: Morgan
lines.text: Then you're in luck. What are you after — something specific, or just browsing?

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: Just browsing, mostly. A good book usually finds me on its own.

lines.speaker: Morgan
lines.text: There are plenty of them here, so its chances are pretty good.

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: I like that confidence in a shopkeeper. Usually it's in short supply.

lines.speaker: Morgan
lines.text: I just know my shelves. If you need anything, don't hesitate to ask.

lines.speaker: Tilde
lines.text: Deal. And… I'm glad you've finally opened.

lines.speaker: Morgan
lines.text: Thank you. Make yourself at home — this is a place you can linger in.
